rawFindings.title: Load errors now exit successfully after SIGINT cleanup
rawFindings.explanation: The SIGINT handler now calls `disconnectBrowsers` without using `process.exitCode`. When load errors are detected during startup, the server sends itself SIGINT; with this handler, cleanup completes via `done(code || 0)` with no code, so the process exits with 0 instead of reporting the startup failure.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore passing the intended exit code on SIGINT, e.g. set a nonzero code before sending SIGINT and keep `processWrapper.on('SIGINT', function () { disconnectBrowsers(process.exitCode) })`, or call `disconnectBrowsers(1)` directly for load errors.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Start the server with a config/plugin that emits a `load_error`; after preprocessing, Karma logs the load error but exits through `done(0)`/success instead of exit code 1.
